sets.relationshipLabel: category and a named instance of it
sets.explanation: A tournament is the category and the World Championship is one real instance of it, just as a venue is the category and Alexandra Palace is a specific example.

sets.relationshipLabel: worker and the tool of their trade
sets.explanation: A thrower's tool is the dart, and in exactly the same way a chalker's tool is the chalk they mark the score with.

sets.relationshipLabel: thing and the feature it has
sets.explanation: A dartboard has its wire segments just as a cabinet has its surround, each a built-in part rather than a separate accessory.

sets.relationshipLabel: signal that announces the thing to come
sets.explanation: Walk-on music always precedes and announces a player's entrance, and this board treats raised arms the same way, as the signal that precedes the win being confirmed.
